foreignObject.div: Douyin image-text cover for a dental clinic campaign about 牙齿不齐要不要做矫正科普信息图. Service focus: 矫正. Audience: 20-35 岁想改善牙齿形象的同城用户. Offer: 免费初筛评估，私信预约优先安排. Scene 3: premium dental clinic interior with warm reception and clean smile branding. The visual scene should match the topic and may be infographic-like, educational, lifestyle-based, or clinic-based as needed. Premium but approachable mainland China aesthetic, local-platform commercial taste, not western stock-photo style. If people appear, they must look like local Chinese people. Do not generate foreign-looking faces. No bloody procedure, no surgery close-up, no exaggerated before-after, no false guarantee. Bright natural light, green and white clinic palette, clean smile, 4:5 vertical composition, high click-through social media cover.
